body.raw: /* ── Colors ── */
/* Danger as TEXT, kept separate from the danger used for surfaces/borders/buttons. A red that reads well
as a button fill is often too low-contrast as small text on the page background, and darkening the one
token would recolour every danger affordance. Defaults to --b-color-danger (custom-property
substitution is lazy, so a theme that overrides only --b-color-danger gets its own red here too);
themes override it where the measured contrast falls below WCAG AA 4.5:1. Used by `.field .error`
and `.required-mark`. */

colored active state (checkbox check, switch/range thumb). Not theme-

/* ── Form-control font size. Defaults to the base body size so inputs match
labels/buttons/b-select on desktop. iOS Safari auto-zooms into a focused
control whose text is < 16px, so the formControl sheet bumps this to 16px
under @media (pointer: coarse); no need to inflate the desktop size here. ── */
/* ── Unified form-control minimum height (rem — scales with font size).
Applied to <input>/<select>/<textarea> via formControlSheet, to
`.combo-container` via comboControlSheet, and to b-tag-input's
container, so every form chrome (plain, searchable, multi-select,
tag-input) has the same vertical footprint. Default ≈ 38px matches
the natural height of an input padded with --b-space-sm × --b-space-md
at --b-text-base font size. Use `size="sm"` / `size="lg"` on the host
component to switch to the compact / comfortable variant. ── */

sheets.prologue:
/* ── Finstat theme ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   Opt-in theme reproducing the Finstat web app's brand look. Extracted from
   Finstat's LESS design tokens (finstat/DevContent/less/, catalogued in
   finstat/LESS_TOKENS.md): brand green primary, warm-grey surfaces, Roboto,
   blue focus, and Finstat's signature flat / square corners (its
   `@border-radius-*` are all 0). Values are Finstat's own hexes; `-light` tints
   and darker hover shades are derived (Finstat had no token for those slots).

   Link AFTER tokens.css:
     <link rel="stylesheet" href="css/tokens.css" />
     <link rel="stylesheet" href="css/themes/finstat.css" />
   Activate with `data-theme="finstat"`; register it in the switcher with
   `registerThemes([BUILTIN_THEMES.finstat])` from birko-web-shell. ── */

sheets.prologue:
/* ── Inverse accent ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   PARTIAL theme: flips only surfaces / text / borders / overlays / shadows /
   tooltip to a dark charcoal, and leaves brand colors (primary, success,
   danger, …), radius, and fonts to INHERIT from the active page theme. Use it
   for dark chrome on a light page — Finstat-style dark top menu + footer —
   where the brand accent must stay on-brand.

   Because it's partial, it's meant to be applied SCOPED, not globally:
     - on a light-DOM region wrapper:  <header data-theme="inverse"> … </header>
     - on a single component host:      <b-card data-theme="inverse"> … </b-card>
     - per shell region via the headerAccent / ribbonAccent / footerAccent hooks
   (Custom properties cross the Shadow DOM boundary, so the nested components
   inherit these surface tokens while keeping the page theme's brand color.) ── */
